items.exampleEn: I went to bed after midnight.
Someday I want to visit Japan.
There is a big calendar on the kitchen wall.
items.exampleZh: 廚房牆上掛著一本大日曆。

items.exampleEn: The museum is quiet on weekdays.

items.exampleZh: 我們來查一下公車時刻表吧。

items.exampleEn: The restaurant is very busy at lunchtime.
items.exampleZh: 這家餐廳午餐時間非常忙。

items.exampleEn: The bus finally came after an hour.
items.exampleZh: 等了一個小時，公車終於來了。

items.sentenceEn: The last train leaves at midnight.
items.sentenceZh: 最後一班火車午夜發車。

items.audioEn: On weekdays, the bus comes every ten minutes.
items.audioZh: 平日公車每十分鐘來一班。

items.sentenceEn: We finally finished the work at noon.
items.sentenceZh: 我們終於在中午把工作做完了。
我午餐時間打電話給你。

items.stemZh: 我們通常在中午吃午餐。

items.stemEn: Let me check the train ____ before we go.
items.stemZh: 出發前我先查一下火車時刻表。

items.passageEn: Nina works in an office from Monday to Friday. On weekdays, she gets up at seven and takes the train at eight. She always checks the timetable first. At lunchtime, she eats with her friends near the office. Last Friday, she worked till midnight because she had a lot of work. She finally got home at one in the morning. "Someday I will take a long holiday," she said.
items.passageZh: Nina 從星期一到星期五在辦公室上班。平日她七點起床、八點搭火車，也總是會先查時刻表。午餐時間，她和朋友在公司附近吃飯。上週五她因為工作很多，一直工作到午夜，終於在凌晨一點才到家。她說：「總有一天我要放個長假。」

questions.questionZh: 上週五 Nina 為什麼工作到午夜？

items.promptZh: 我把會議寫在行事曆上了。
referenceEn: I wrote the meeting on my calendar.
I have put the meeting on my calendar.
rubricZh: 「寫在行事曆上」可寫例如 on my calendar、in my calendar
用過去式或現在完成式（例如 wrote、have put、added）

items.instructionZh: 用 someday 造一個句子，說說你將來想做的一件事。
referenceEn: Someday I want to open my own cafe.
I hope I can buy a house by the sea someday.
rubricZh: someday 表示「將來總有一天」，放句首或句尾都可以（例如 Someday I…、…someday）
說想做的事可用例如 want to、hope to、will
